levels.surface: محمد بن جعفر الرزاز القرشي الكوفي
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «أو غيره» after سعيد بن يسار is written as an alternative in the same level; it is not clear whether it marks a second transmitter or a hedge, so it is read as an unnamed alternative and needs a ruling; the second and third isnads follow the saying, the third ends at سعد بن يسار because «مثله» names no Imam; «(ع)», «(رحمه الله)» are glosses; «حدثني أبي» with no name is a relation
